UK Monthly Trade Report

September 2026

Author

Oleksandr Shepotylo

Published

September 30, 2026

Executive Summary

This report analyzes UK trade patterns for September 2026, comparing performance to:

  • August 2026 (Month-over-Month analysis)
  • September 2025 (Year-over-Year analysis)

The analysis covers:

  1. Overall trade metrics (exports, imports, trade balance)
  2. Top 10 products with largest absolute changes in value
  3. Top 5 trading partners with largest absolute changes in value

4. Methodology

Data Source

  • Source: Trade Data Monitor (TDM) API
  • Reporter: United Kingdom
  • Period: September 2025 - September 2026
  • Product Classification: Harmonized System (HS) 6-digit codes
  • Trade Flows: Both exports (E) and imports (I)

Calculations

Growth Rates

  • Month-over-Month (MoM): Comparison of September 2026 to August 2026
  • Year-over-Year (YoY): Comparison of September 2026 to September 2025

Rankings

  • Products: Ranked by absolute change in value (USD)
  • Countries: Ranked by absolute change in total trade value (USD)
  • Top 10 products and top 5 countries shown for both increases and decreases

Notes

  • All values are in US Dollars (USD)
  • Trade balance = Exports - Imports (negative values indicate trade deficit)
  • Percentage changes may be undefined for products/countries with zero trade in comparison period
